paragraphs.text: B.O.B , known as the Bevy of Beebles , is an acorn planeswalker who is composed of a group (or bevy) of Beebles .

B.O.B. is a character that first appeared in the acorn Unsanctioned set. It is currently unknown how their spark works or how it is shared among numerous Beebles . Their being a group is represented by their loyalty with it being equal to the number of Beebles the player controls, starting with it creating 4 Beeble tokens. Beeble tokens are then further created or sacrificed as loyalty is gained or lost. All of the Beebles in the bevy have a similar appearance of rounded pink bodies.
